title: Grocery list for tacos for four
summary: A checked list for four people: tortillas, protein, toppings, and the two things you always forget.

blocks.eyebrow: Dinner for four, one store run
blocks.title: Tacos, not a project plan
blocks.body: This is the shopping list. Quantities assume four adults eating about three tacos each. Swap the protein if you want — the rest of the list barely moves.

items.label: 12 soft corn or flour tortillas
items.detail: A 10-pack plus two extras beats running short mid-assembly.

items.label: 1.5 lb ground beef, chicken thighs, or a block of firm tofu
items.detail: Season with chili powder, cumin, salt, and a squeeze of lime.

items.label: 1 yellow onion and 2 limes
items.detail: Half the onion for the filling, half diced raw on top.

items.label: 1 head cilantro, 1 avocado, 8 oz shredded cheese
items.detail: Skip the avocado if it is rock-hard and overpriced today.

items.label: Salsa and sour cream
items.detail: One jar and one small tub cover four people without leftovers rotting.

items.label: Hot sauce you already like
items.detail: Only if the cabinet is empty — this is the classic forget-and-regret item.

blocks.title: Check the pantry before you leave
blocks.body: Oil, salt, cumin, and chili powder are usually already there. Buying duplicates of spice jars is how a taco night becomes a $60 errand.

blocks.heading: Cook order once you are home
items: Brown and season the protein while the onion softens in the same pan.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet or wrapped in a damp towel in a low oven.
Dice the raw onion, chop cilantro, slice avocado, set out cheese and salsa.
Build at the table — people eat more calmly when assembly is not a bottleneck.
